Attached: 1 image

A 15-item to-do list ends the day mostly unchecked, and you go to bed feeling behind.

Before you start today, write only nine things on a sticky note: 1 big task, 3 medium tasks, 5 small ones under 15 minutes.

When a tenth shows up, it goes on tomorrow's list. Do the big task before email.

#productivity
